key_insight: LLMs answer precision-medicine questions more accurately when they can retrieve evidence that closely matches the patient’s PICO details.
clinical_relevance: For clinical decision support, having evidence that fits the patient scenario—not just any relevant paper—appears critical to producing faithful, usable AI responses.
method: Built Precision Evidence Bench: 209 synthetic clinical questions with explicit PICO elements.
Scored answers with a five-item rubric for PICO match and faithful source reporting.
Tested four frontier LLMs with web search, then with added precision evidence corpora of 100M and 500M pEBFs.
evidence_signal: Precision match rates rose from 13–18% with web search alone to 17–28% with 100M pEBFs and 41–56% with 500M pEBFs across models.
watch_item: Results come from synthetic questions and retrieval settings, so real-world clinical use still needs careful validation for safety, coverage, and citation faithfulness.
paper_title: Precision Evidence Bench: Assessing PICO alignment and faithful reporting in clinical AI
